title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional student spaces and quiet corners across Bellarmine University's Highlands campus that define the daily Knight experience.

cards.title: The All-Night Study Hub
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, Level 1
cards.notes: Access this reliable space any time of day for late-night projects. It features computers, vending machines, and a coffee maker to fuel long sessions.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated 24/7 study space in the library equipped with technology and refreshments.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has a 24-hour study room available to students daily featuring computers, desks, a coffee maker, and vending machine.
cards.source_title: Seven ways the Bellarmine Library supports student success
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for students with valid ID.

cards.title: The Campus Living Room
cards.subtitle: Centro, Horrigan Hall 1st Floor
cards.notes: Relax by the fireplace or play a game of billiards in this cozy lounge. It is a primary social spot for both commuters and residents.
cards.short_summary: A central campus lounge in Centro featuring a fireplace, billiards, and comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Knights Knook is a lounge area located on the 1st floor of Centro with lounge furniture, a fireplace, and a billiards table.
cards.access_notes: Located in the main campus center; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: Tuscan-Style Green Space
cards.subtitle: Siena Residence Complex
cards.notes: Gather at the fire pit or sit by the water feature in this landscaped courtyard. It serves as a scenic outdoor amphitheater for student events.
cards.short_summary: A central green space in the Siena complex featuring a fire pit and water feature.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboreto is a Tuscan-style green space at the center of the Siena complex with an amphitheater, fire pit, and water feature.
cards.source_title: Siena Terzo and Quarto - Residence Halls
cards.access_notes: Outdoor courtyard accessible to the campus community.

cards.title: World-Class Archive Gallery
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: View original manuscripts and drawings by the famous monk. The reading room offers a quiet, scholarly atmosphere for browsing his works.
cards.short_summary: The official repository of Thomas Merton's works, featuring a gallery and reading room.
cards.evidence_claim: The Thomas Merton Center is located on the second floor of the library and is open to casual visitors Monday-Friday, 9 am - 4 pm.

cards.title: The Student Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Centro, Horrigan Hall 1st Floor
cards.notes: Heat up your lunch or store snacks in the shared refrigerator. This functional space is essential for students spending long days on campus.
cards.short_summary: A student kitchenette in Centro equipped with a refrigerator, microwave, and air fryer.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pit Stop is a kitchen area on the 1st floor of Centro with a refrigerator, sink, air fryer, and microwave.
cards.access_notes: Located across from Cafe Ogle; available during building hours.

cards.title: Recreational Free Play
cards.subtitle: Sport, Recreation and Fitness Center
cards.notes: Drop in for a pickup game of basketball or tennis. The center is a primary hub for non-varsity physical activity and intramural sports.
cards.short_summary: Indoor courts for basketball and tennis available for student recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The SuRF Center offers two basketball courts and three tennis courts for student use and intramural sports.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Monday-Thursday during fall/spring semesters.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady of the Woods Chapel
cards.title: Woodland Sanctuary
cards.subtitle: Bellarmine Boulevard
cards.notes: Visit this glass and steel masterpiece for a moment of quiet reflection. It is tucked away in a wooded area, offering a peaceful escape from campus noise.
cards.short_summary: A modern glass and wood chapel located in a quiet wooded area of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Our Lady of the Woods Chapel is a place of worship and art nestled on a hill in the woods, serving students of all faith traditions.
cards.source_title: About Our Lady of the Woods Chapel
cards.access_notes: Open for daily prayer and scheduled services.

cards.title: The Deep Focus Zone
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Utilize the whiteboards and large desks for intense individual study. This floor is strictly designated for silence to ensure maximum concentration.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent study area on the library's second floor with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: On Level 2, a large 'silent study space' welcomes students to fill whiteboards with notes or focus on textbooks.
cards.source_title: Seven ways the Bellarmine Library supports student success

cards.title: The End Zone Energy
cards.subtitle: Knights Hall
cards.notes: Join the crowd in the designated student end zone for basketball and volleyball games. It offers an intimate, high-energy atmosphere close to the court.
cards.short_summary: The dedicated student seating area in the historic on-campus arena.
cards.evidence_claim: Knights Hall provides an intimate feel with a student section in one end zone for basketball and volleyball programs.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during athletic events; student ID often required for section access.

cards.title: Inclusive Social Space
cards.subtitle: Centro, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Stop by this casual office and lounge to socialize or attend community events. It is a welcoming hub for students from diverse backgrounds.
cards.short_summary: A social and event space in Centro focused on diversity and inclusion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carver Center office on the first floor of Centro is a great casual space to socialize and hosts events for students from diverse backgrounds.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard university business hours.
